2607.07035.title: On the Principles of Deep Feedforward ReLU Networks
2607.07035.paper_summary: The architecture of deep feedforward neural networks is ubiquitous in deep learning, either as a whole system or as a subnetwork of other architectures, and thus its mechanism is a key ingredient of the black box of neural networks. On the basis of the simplest two-layer ReLU network, this paper systematically studies the mechanism of deep feedforward ReLU networks with multiple hidden layers and successfully explains the training solution obtained by the back-propagation algorithm. The concept of a path, especially in terms of the relationships between paths, plays a central role in uncovering the mystery of the black box. It is shown that a unit of a deep ReLU network can form a piecewise linear manifold to divide the input space, instead of a hyperplane of the two-layer case. How to efficiently use the hidden-layer units to produce both linear functions and partitions of the input space is also a central problem. The principles of a two-layer ReLU network can be generalized to the deeper case to a large extent, such as multiple strict partial orders and continuity restriction. The combination of the basic and simple principles proposed can yield complicated instantiations including the training solutions, and in this sense the black box of deep feedforward ReLU networks is revealed.
2607.07035.paper_summary_zh: 深度前饋神經網絡的架構在深度學習中無處不在，無論是作為整個系統還是其他架構的子網絡，因此其機制是神經網絡黑箱的關鍵成分。基於最簡單的兩層ReLU網絡，本文系統性地研究了多隱藏層深度前饋ReLU網絡的機制，並成功解釋了通過反向傳播算法獲得的訓練解決方案。路徑的概念，特別是在路徑之間的關係方面，對揭示黑箱的神秘性起著核心作用。研究表明，深度ReLU網絡的一個單元可以形成分段線性流形來劃分輸入空間，而不是兩層情況下的超平面。如何有效利用隱藏層單元來產生線性函數和輸入空間的劃分也是一個核心問題。兩層ReLU網絡的原則在很大程度上可以推廣到更深的情況，例如多個嚴格的部分順序和連續性限制。所提出的基本和簡單原則的結合可以產生複雜的實例，包括訓練解決方案，從這個意義上說，深度前饋ReLU網絡的黑箱被揭示出來。
2607.07035.author: Changcun Huang et.al.
